cohort: The study participants were women who had deliveries between June 1, 2020, and October 1, 2024, at a tertiary referral centre in Turkiye.
finding: The overall caesarean section rate was 54.2%, with Robson Group 5 being the largest contributor.
mod_finding: The overall caesarean section rate varied by year and nationality, with Turkish cases having a higher rate than refugees, and Robson Group 5 contributing most significantly to the overall rate.
